title: Price Band Harmonization & Customer-Facing Limits Migration Roadmap
creator: Asha Menon
description: Coordinate cross-functional activities to harmonize price bands (SKUs) and migrate customer-facing usage limits. Deliver a staged migration plan that minimizes billing disruption, preserves entitlement integrity, and equips Sales/CS with clear messaging and assets. This ticket owns the roadmap, milestone coordination, release notes timing, and final sign-off checklist for cutover windows.
acceptance_criteria: SKU mapping table finalized and approved by Finance and Legal
Migration runbook validated in staging with synthetic customer cohort (>=3 scenarios)
Billing team confirms reconciliation queries and backfill steps documented
Sales enablement material (FAQ, objections, pricing cheat-sheet) reviewed and published to Drive
Release notes draft reviewed and scheduled for multi-channel distribution (console, email, changelog)
tasks: Finalize SKU rename and equivalence matrix (Finance + PM)
Define per-customer limit migration windows and rollback criteria
Create staging migration job and validate entitlement preservation
Coordinate billing reconciliation scripts with Finance/Revenue Ops
Draft customer comms and segment by cohort for phased emails
Prepare Sales training session and internal playbook
Schedule Console UI copy updates and release notes entries
Establish post-cutover monitoring dashboard (cost, failed migrations, customer support volume)
updates: 2025-01-22: Initial scoping workshop completed with Finance, Billing, and Eng. Agreed on three migration cohorts (low usage, medium usage, strategic customers).
2025-01-29: Draft SKU equivalence table created; Finance requested additional margin-preservation checks. Assigned to Diego to incorporate price floor constraints.
2025-02-05: Eng spike to estimate migration job runtime. Estimated 6 hours for full-tenant backfill in worst case; recommended rolling approach per region.
2025-02-12: Legal provided guidance on billing notice language. PM team updated customer comms draft to include prorated and effective-date sections.
2025-02-20: Sales enablement assets (deck + one-pager) ready for review. Training session tentatively scheduled for 2025-03-03.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Incorrect entitlement mapping could cause overcharging or service disruption. Mitigation: run migration in staging with 3 synthetic cohorts, add per-tenant dry-run mode, implement granular rollback that re-applies original entitlements and triggers reconciliation pipeline. Escalation path defined with on-call billing engineer and Finance lead.
communications_plan: Phased approach: 1) Internal comms and training (2 weeks prior), 2) Soft notice to affected customers (1 week prior) for medium+ usage cohorts, 3) Public release notes on changelog and console banner on cutover day. Email templates and FAQ will be versioned; legal-approved billing language mandatory. Post-cutover follow-up email with reconciliation outcome for impacted customers.
release_notes_timing: Draft due 2025-02-28; Legal review by 2025-03-04; Final publish aligned with console release on 2025-03-14
support_playbook: CS and Support will use scripted triage: identify customer cohort -> check migration job status -> run entitlement reconciliation query -> escalate to billing on anomalies. Playbook stored in Drive with runbook links and contact matrix.
qa_plan: End-to-end validation in staging using synthetic customers across three cohorts. Validation checklist: tokenized billing records match expected usage mapping, limits enforced correctly in console, rate-limit tests pass, rollback tested successfully. Smoke tests in production post-cutover for first 24 hours.
eng_assumptions: Billing API supports idempotent migration calls; migration job can be scoped per-tenant; logs expose original and migrated SKU IDs for reconciliation.
open_questions: Do we require customer opt-in for accounts with contractual commitments?
Should strategic customers be migrated manually by RevOps or via automation?
What SLA does Finance require for reconciliation completion after cutover?
